summary.text: Lisa Frizell, a Republican, represents District 2 (Douglas County) in the Colorado State Senate, where the General Assembly lists her as Assistant Minority Leader.

paragraphs.text: She has held the Senate seat since January 2025, after serving in the Colorado House of Representatives (District 45) from 2023 to 2025.
She earned a B.S. in engineering from the University of Colorado Boulder in 1984.
She previously served as the assessor of Douglas County and as board chair of the Castle Rock Chamber of Commerce.
